loi_cham_giua_radio.trieu_chung: DOM bao radio 'Manual' dang chon (input.checked=true, wrapper co lop Mui-checked) nhung hinh ve cham giua van nam o 'Automatic'
loi_cham_giua_radio.nguyen_nhan: MUI xep chong 2 <svg> trong moi radio: RadioButtonUncheckedIcon (vong tron) va RadioButtonCheckedIcon (cham giua). Cham giua an/hien bang 'transform: scale(0|1)' do LOP EMOTION quy dinh, KHONG phai do lop Mui-checked.
loi_cham_giua_radio.vi_sao_ban_chup_bi_dong_cung: Luc chup, React da gan san lop tuong ung TRANG THAI LUC DO cho tung radio. File tinh giu nguyen hai lop nay mai mai, nen doi lop Mui-checked khong lam cham di chuyen.
loi_cham_giua_radio.cach_sua: Ghi de theo DUNG ngu nghia MUI trong interact.js injectCss(): '.PrivateSwitchBase-root svg[data-testid="RadioButtonCheckedIcon"]{transform:scale(0)}' va '.PrivateSwitchBase-root.Mui-checked svg[...]{transform:scale(1)}'. Do sau chon lop (0,2,1) cao hon lop Emotion (0,1,0) nen khong can !important. KHONG sua file CSS bang chung goc.
